svg.desc: South Helwan Substations LOCATION Egypt CLIENT General Electric (GE)/EETC COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2017 150 million EGP DISCIPLINES Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2017 in Helwan, Egypt, this substation project for General Electric (GE) and EETC involved providing architecture, structural and civil engineering, MEP, and technical support services. BECT's scope included detailed drawings, tender documents and site supervision. The multidisciplinary services covered structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
